name: Industrial Automation & Control Systems

seo.title: Industrial Automation Services | FEINCORE INNOVATIONS

name: Machine Vision & AI-Based Inspection

imageAlt: Machine vision system inspecting a manufactured part
serviceOverview: Machine vision applications are developed around the inspection objective, product variation, line speed, and available installation space. A study evaluates camera and lens selection, lighting, image capture timing, inspection logic, operator feedback, reject handling, and result logging. Performance is validated against agreed sample parts and acceptance criteria.

serviceOverview: Robotic applications are planned around payload, reach, cycle time, part presentation, tooling, and operator interaction. The study can cover cell layout, robot and end-effector selection, machine handshakes, material flow, guarding, safety controls, recovery procedures, and commissioning. Final suitability depends on site conditions and a documented risk assessment.

name: Industrial Machine Retrofitting & Modernization
shortDescription: Assess suitable existing equipment for modernization, reuse, or integration into another application.
description: Not every outdated machine needs to be replaced. FEINCORE INNOVATIONS can assess suitable equipment for modernization, reuse, or integration into another application. Modernization is subject to equipment condition, technical feasibility, safety requirements, and economic evaluation.
benefits: Evaluate reuse before replacement where suitable

seo.title: Machine Retrofitting & Modernization | FEINCORE INNOVATIONS

A retrofit scope may include selected PLC or HMI upgrades, sensor additions, connectivity, and data acquisition. Reuse is recommended only where technical feasibility, safety, and economics support it.
